description: Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Mobilität. Der Datensatz zeigt die Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs im Kanton Basel-Stadt sowie teilweise in der trinationalen Agglomeration. Es wird nach Transportunternehmen, Art und Typ der Haltestelle unterschieden. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport, Territory and environment, Administration. Its keywords are Tram, Bus, Zug, Haltestelle, Baustelle, Umleitung. The portal shows 846 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
